about_the_game:
You are deployed into a FRACTURE system that should have ceased functioning long ago.
The system no longer recognizes your identity, yet insists you execute a series of broken "test protocols."
You begin traversing the shattered starfield, fighting, and recording.

Until finally — a mysterious battleship obliterates you.
Not to eliminate you, but to terminate the system that should no longer be running.

Explore a Shattered Rift Universe

Navigate and fight across multiple stylistic zones — from asteroid wreckfields to corrupted mega-stations.
Use your Rift Drive to freely traverse an open map scattered with lost system remnants and anomalous phenomena.

Bullet Hell Combat & High-Mobility Flight

Engage in tactical top-down battles using boost, warp-dash, and burst propulsion.
Adapt your strategy against diverse enemy behaviors and patterns.

Weapon Customization & Upgrade System

  • Equip up to 3 weapons per ship: bullets, lasers, missiles, and more

  • Each weapon supports customizable spread, cooldown, tracking, and energy parameters

  • Upgrade paths extend usage time, reduce cooldown, or unlock special combat modifiers

  • Rare weapons possess unique "Rift-Mutated" abilities

Fragmented Narrative Structure

System Rebooting...
✦ Current Node: Executing Test Protocol #001
✦ Identity Match Failed: You are not a registered unit
✦ Reinitializing Protocol...【Success】

You wake up among the wreckage of a destroyed fleet.
The task system instructs you to activate testing zones, disable interference units, and stabilize system functions.

Everything seems routine — until you complete three tests, and the mysterious battleship appears.
It ignores all other targets and annihilates only you.

You awaken again. Everything has reset.
The system greets you: "This is your first entry."

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen 5 2600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 - 4GB or Radeon RX 470 - 4GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

short_description: FRACTURE is a top-down 3D space shooter RPG, blending open-world exploration and fragmented memory-driven storytelling.It throws you into a recursive war shaped by identity, consciousness, and fate.You haven't come here for the first time—But are you sure... you've ever truly left?
